items.corrections: Review says the origin of the code remains mechanistically unresolved and that formal scenarios do not yet connect it credibly to coding/translation. The cited PNAS paper proposes one scenario. The exact prebiotic cause, fixation history, universality mechanism, and orthogonal-code impacts remain unestablished.

Enformer improved gene-expression/variant-effect prediction from DNA sequence and long-range interactions in evaluated tasks. Universal exact predictions for every cell/stage/condition and perfect therapy/cell-fate design are not shown.

A mouse paternal-trauma model reported selected behavioral/metabolic phenotypes through F3/F4. Does not demonstrate a general mammalian heritable-mark system or the asserted human medical/evolutionary impact.

A rotifer species complex showed 7-fold genome-size variation, with repeats explaining at least 54% in that study. Does not explain >100,000-fold variation across eukaryotes or all selective forces and complexity relationships.

A screen of 42 candidate Drosophila de novo genes validated atlas as required for a specific spermatid phenotype. Does not identify or integrate every lineage-specific gene or establish broad species-difference/agriculture/drug impacts.

A tRNA experimental landscape measured pairwise interactions whose sign depended on genetic background. Not a complete genome-wide or gene-environment map, variance accounting, or resolution of unexplained heritability.

A Drosophila somatic-cell study found piRNA pathway knockdown increased expression of multiple transposons. No universal mechanism across taxa/elements or proof of genome-wide prevention, editing safety, or synthetic chromosome safety.

A model plus chicken expression analysis linked some dosage-compensation patterns with selection measures; results varied by tissue. Not complete evolutionary rules for all sex chromosome origins or demonstrated chromosomal cures/synthetic systems.

Drosophila studies map specific hybrid rescue/incompatibility genes and one defined interspecies model. Not exact nucleotide-level incompatibilities across lineages or predictive management of hybridization/speciation collapse.

One laboratory cytochrome P450 evolution study found greater protein robustness in larger populations. Not a universal genomic theory or demonstrated long-term prediction and organism engineering capability.
